name: oneshot
description: One orchestrator, one label: a deterministic conductor that drives GitLab tickets from label to Ready For Deployment through fresh per-phase Claude sessions — pipelined, with one ticket at a time in the merge→deploy→qa window.

scripts.verify: npm run deps:verify && npm run hooks:verify && npm run doctor
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && for f in hooks/*.cjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo 'check clean'
